lines.text: It is the symbol of a nation — the bald eagle, wings wide, fearless and free, soaring above a country hosting the world this summer. The United States, rising, hungry, and finally believing.
But out of the mountains of the Balkans come the Dragons — proud, fierce, and afraid of no one. Tonight, the eagle meets the dragon.
Welcome back to WorldCup twenty-six Legends — episode eighty-six. The USA, versus Bosnia and Herzegovina. A knockout. Win, or the dream dies right here.
The USA arrive as co-hosts, young and fearless. Bosnia arrive as the Dragons — battle-hardened, dangerous, led by a legend who never stops scoring.
The USA — the Stars and Stripes. Fast, fearless, and roared on by a whole nation.
Christian Pulisic is the captain and the talisman who makes them tick. Tim Weah flies down the flank with pace. And Folarin Balogun leads the line with a striker's cold eye.
Weston McKennie drives the midfield box to box. And Tyler Adams snaps it shut and starts it again.
Bosnia — the Dragons. Strong, proud, and utterly without fear of any badge or any name.
Edin Dzeko leads the line and wears the armband — a born finisher, ageless and ruthless. Miralem Pjanic conducts the tempo with elegance. And Ermedin Demirovic battles for every ball.
Smail Tabakovic carries the threat up front. And Sead Kolasinac is a wall who tames the very best.
So here is the riddle. Does the Eagle finally soar when it matters most? Or does the Dragon breathe fire and drag the hosts into the dark?
And stay with me — because this one turns, late, on a roar from the home crowd.
Here is how we see it. Bosnia come out fearless, pressing high, and the hosts are rattled early by the steel and the snarl.
The Dragon strikes first. The whole stadium freezes.
And it lands. Edin Dzeko pounces in the box and finishes ice-cold. Bosnia lead. The Dragon has drawn blood.
But this eagle does not fall. The USA steady, the noise rises, and the hosts begin to believe.
And Christian Pulisic does what captains do. He levels it, cool and clinical. One — one. The eagle is climbing now.
And then, late, the roar. Folarin Balogun strikes, and the stadium erupts. Two — one, USA. The Eagle has the lead.
Two — one. Bosnia were magnificent, and fearless, and so nearly there — but the hosts found a way, the way the great ones do.
Our prediction — USA two, Bosnia one. Balogun, late. Not played yet — the real ninety is yours to watch.
And Bosnia leave with their heads high — the Dragon that terrified the hosts, undone only in the dying minutes.
The USA march on. The eagle, reminding the world that this young nation is ready to fly.
So you tell me — the eagle, or the dragon? Comment USA for the Stars and Stripes — comment BOSNIA for the Dragons of the Balkans.
Above the canyons and the cities it has reigned forever — golden-eyed and unbroken, the wings of a nation that bows to no one. Legend eighty-six — the American Eagle, Spirit of the Free.
The players write the night. But the Eagle carries one truth — you are only ever beaten when you stop climbing back.
Here is how. Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world and create your free account — ten seconds, and the American Eagle, Legend eighty-six, unlocks the moment you sign up.
Then pick three of the forty-eight nations, and every goal they score, scores for you. Free to play, just for fun. No prizes — only glory.
So sign up tonight, claim your Legend, and send this to someone who flies. Hit like, subscribe — and I'll see you when the next legend rises from the dark.
